description: helpers.rs: both map_or_null and array_or_null have #[allow(dead_code)] suppression, which means they are not currently used. Dead code in a library that is pub(crate) is low risk but the suppression masks a real signal: these functions were written and never called. Either they should be used (replacing inline null-collapsing) or removed. A contributor who sees them may add new call sites; if the helpers are incorrect, the error propagates. The #[allow(dead_code)] should be removed and the functions either deleted or used.
title: helpers.rs map_or_null/array_or_null are dead code (#[allow(dead_code)])
